extra.reason: Fixed: normalize.py build_almanac() was multiplying elevation by 3.28084 (meters->feet) on top of an already-unit-correct value from Pirate Weather (the module's own docstring confirms the API returns values in the requested unit system already). Removed the extra conversion.

Fixed: layers/hourly_graph.py drew each series' area-fill immediately followed by its line, and area_fill() does a raw masked paste (not alpha blend), so each later series' fill wiped out the previous series' fill+line wherever they overlapped. Temperature was drawn last and buried cloud/precip. Restructured to draw all three fills first, then all three lines, so no fill can ever paint over an already-drawn line.
